name: jimmytrade
caption:
THE JIMMY TRADE 🎮🏀 We sent Andrew Wiggins to Miami. Back came Jimmy Butler. Who won?

• Feb 6, 2025: five-team deal, Wiggins headlines the package to Miami
• Debut: 25 points in a 132-111 win over Chicago
• Play-in: 38 vs Memphis, then we knock out Houston in Game 7
• Last season: 20.0 PPG in 38 games, we were 25-19 when he tore his ACL on Jan 19, 2026

Who won the trade? 👇

beats.vo: Wiggins for Jimmy. Who won the trade? Comment below.

facts.claim: On February 6, 2025, Butler was traded to Golden State in a five-team deal that sent a package headed by Andrew Wiggins to Miami; debut 25 points in a 132–111 win over Chicago; 38 points in the play-in win over Memphis; Warriors eliminated the Rockets in game 7; torn right ACL on January 19, 2026; through 38 games averaged 20.0 points with the Warriors 25–19 at the time of injury
